_help.about: [The sacred fig wired (Uniques; design §CL) — its faint path in from a road, roots on old stone, the leaves' own flutter and the hood down NOT WIRED YET] One-of-a-kind places: each appears exactly once in a world. The sites pass (§CK) places it where its `where` holds, off a road like the §BC landmarks (40-120 m from the trail and out of sight of it, with a faint path in), built to the composition rules (LOOK_REFERENCE: a straight last approach, walls either side, an apron in front). It is never a camp and never a ruin. Restart after editing.
_help.fields: name · count_per_world (always 1) · where (biomes in order of preference; the first the world has wins; other: plain words) · tree (the species and how this one specimen differs from the wild ones) · figure (who is there: the shared cloaked rig, pose, colours, behaviour) · ground (the clearing) · sound · log (the line written the first time you come within reach) · open (calls still with the designer).
_help.rig: Every figure uses the player's cloaked rig (one rig, §0); a figure here is a pose and a palette, never a new body. The player's indigo-and-rust is reserved for the player.

sacred_fig.name: The sacred fig

where.other: A level clearing on a low rise in tropical dry forest (else monsoon jungle, else savanna woodland), off a road, not in a wetland or on a slope; the oldest tree for kilometres. If old stone is near (a ruin wall, a boulder), the tree grows out of it.

tree.size: Past the top of the species' band: about 30 m tall, the crown 35-45 m across, the trunk a fused mass of old grey stems several metres round.
tree.notes: Heart-shaped leaves with a long drip-tip tail on long, slender stalks, so they tremble in still air (the wind shader has no per-species flutter yet: §CL asks for one here). Smooth pale grey bark. Roots gripping stone where it started on a wall. Purple-black figs in pairs in the leaf axils in season; birds and bats in the crown.

figure.rig: the cloaked figure, folk scale (~1.7 m standing)
figure.pose: seated in meditation under the crown on the east side of the trunk, facing east: legs crossed, hands resting together in the lap, back straight, eyes closed, hood down

robe.notes: an ochre robe; one shade throughout, no pattern

figure.moves: never, but to breathe; nothing the player does changes that

sacred_fig.ground: Bare swept earth in a ring under the crown, fallen leaves at its edge; a few flat stones; no fire, no tools, no store.
sacred_fig.sound: The leaves' dry rustle over everything; birds in the crown by day.
sacred_fig.log: Someone sits beneath the old fig, very still.
open: Naming (Mike): Mike asked for the Buddha meditating beneath it. Play names nobody (§BO keeps real names out of play), so the default is no name and the image speaks for itself; say if the log or a label should name him.
Night (Mike): does the dark keep away from this place, a still circle with no fire? Default: no special rule until Mike decides.
